chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers of Darkness.
chapter_note: The chapter is dominated by systematic cosmological-correspondential description of the Ruler of Darkness (five body-forms sourced from the five dark worlds, plus additional triads of qualities). It opens with a dialogue/"apostle" frame (later compilation layer) and ends with a clear exhortatory application to the audience (pastoral/application drift), consistent with editorial fatigue in the second half.

paragraphs.core_text: Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of darkness. Now, five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: "Once again, the apostle is sitting among the congregation. He says to his disciples:" (hagiographic compilation frame; 'apostle' and staged sitting/teaching scene).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core teaching begins with impersonal system-description (five forms ↔ five creations ↔ five worlds of darkness), but it is introduced by a later Kephalaia dialogue frame using 'apostle' and a staged setting.

paragraphs.core_text: Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic substrate mapping: body-part/shape correspondence anchored entirely within the five dark worlds and their 'children' (cosmos→cosmos; no contemporary application).

paragraphs.core_text: Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [ ... ] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [ ... ] four [ ... ] on his hands and feet [ ... ] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal functional exposition (shape-shifting capacities) continuing the five-form system; lacunae do not obscure that this remains internal cosmology.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative structural marker introducing a triad; typical systematic teaching connective without exhortation/citation.
Fragmentary, but it preserves the numbered, schematic teaching format (triadic qualities) characteristic of the core layer.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: Shall a [ ... ] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Describes an internal faculty/operation of the dark ruler (magic arts as mechanism), not a polemic about contemporary practitioners; remains cosmos→cosmos.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: His body is strong, a[1]] [ ... ] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [ ... ]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mechanistic description of composition/indestructibility (metal comparison) and origin from personified Matter; fully within the mythic-cosmological system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, there are three others in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second triad-introduction in the same schematic voice; indicates structured teaching units.

paragraphs.core_text: When he wants, his fire shall blaze, and his entire body be made like the [ ... of] fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-physical transformation property stated impersonally; correspondence stays within elemental/cosmic register.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [ ... of] snow.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal, descriptive catalogue of powers (heat/cold); no audience address or institutional reference.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [ ... ] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cognitive/affective mechanics of the ruler (limited perception; 'life' as bile of anger) in impersonal exposition; still system-internal.

Direct exhortation and audience address ('my beloved ones'; imperatives 'do not lay up... Hold yourselves secure') applies the cosmology to behavior—late application layer, matching the chapter’s second-half drift.

Continues exhortation ('do you become zealous and perfect...') aimed at the hearers; soteriological promise ('inherit life') rather than system-description, indicating editorial/pastoral application rather than the impersonal teaching substrate.
